digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud/Data Center adapter user identity model
propositions: Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId while Data Center identifies them by name, requiring a unified contract abstraction
PR #120's DC implementation using getattr-discovered _assignee_resolver has an unreachable authoritative branch, causing permanent non-authoritative assignee resolution and preventable diff churn
UserIdentityModel Protocol must provide resolve(local_value, remote_identity) returning (value, authoritative, is_account_id) tuple and to_payload(value) for deployment-specific assignee field shape
NameIdentity implementation must perform real lookup against DC user-search endpoint to achieve authoritative=True for resolvable assignees, preventing churn unlike the PR #120 fallback
A parameterized contract test over both identity models must verify 3-state resolution (empty, converged, different) and DC anti-churn oracle (authoritative=True for resolvable assignee)
Unresolvable assignees must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning non-authoritative values
